correctness.rationale: For each even h>=4 the admissible endpoint residues modulo the primorial are enumerated by Chinese remainder theorem. An exact survivor-mask dynamic program over odd primes p<h exhausts every admissible residue tuple, deleting even inner offsets as residue classes strike them. An independently implemented complete finite CRT program reproduced ALL 31 Omega_h counts for h=4,6,...,64 (including all 14 new h>=38 values); a structurally distinct inclusion-exclusion sum independently reproduced 15 entries through h=32. The exact partial sum through 64 is 61370211356863231369/29555095284933631875. A separate integer sieve and sequential floor product over 78497 odd primes <=10^6 reproduced L=1320323721179642234 on 1e18 scale; product tail >=999998/999999; their exact rational product equals 1841554176617798769290824758236675208498257/671706039314507885031093750000000000000000 >2741607/1000000. Nonnegative uncomputed h terms justify unconditional strict lower bound on defined constant, not prime-gap asymptotics.
